# GetGraphicsRefreshRate <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetGraphicsRefreshRate:Float32
```

**Returns:** The most frames per second that Flip allows, or 0 for no limit.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells the limit that [SetGraphicsRefreshRate](SetGraphicsRefreshRate) set. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetGraphicsRefreshRate()
```
